info.title: Finnish Railway Traffic Universal API
info.description: Open railway traffic data for Finland from Fintraffic's Digitraffic service, including live trains, timetables, train locations, passenger information messages, route sets, compositions, track work and traffic restriction notifications, and railway metadata.

get.description: Retrieves the latest train by number from Finnish Railway Traffic.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: trainNumber
parameters.description: Train number, for example 1.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
